response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers 'primerané a nevyhnutné náklady na ambulantné ošetrenie... ak boli vynaložené v dôsledku akútneho ochorenia alebo úrazu počas cesty.' The evidence confirms the injury occurred during the trip and required medical treatment. No exclusions apply, as the injury is not related to a pre-existing condition, alcohol, extreme sports (covered under the Premium product), or other general exclusions."}
